items.claim: Coloplast oplyste, at Finanstilsynet har givet dispensation fra pligten til at fremsætte et pligtmæssigt overtagelsestilbud, så en kontrollerende indirekte ejerandel kan overdrages fra NPLH Holding ApS til en almennyttig fond.
Coloplast beskrev overdragelsen som led i et generationsskifte: "The contemplated transfer of a controlling indirect ownership interest in Coloplast A/S is part of a generational change."
Niels Peter Louis-Hansen har ifølge meddelelsen informeret selskabet om, at gennemførelsen forventes omkring 1. oktober 2026.
items.source: Niels Peter Louis-Hansen, gengivet i Coloplasts selskabsmeddelelse

items.claim: Coloplast A/S published its Financial Calendar for the 2026/27 financial year, referring readers to an attached PDF and to its investor relations financial-calendar page.
items.source: Coloplast A/S, company announcement; contacts named as Anders Lonning-Skovgaard (EVP and CFO), Kristine Husted Munk and Nicklas Overgaard (Investor Relations) and Peter Monster (Media Relations)

items.claim: Coloplast A/S issued the same announcement in Danish as "Finanskalender 2026/27", again pointing to the enclosed PDF and its investor relations site.

MarketScreener carried Coloplast's Financial Calendar 2026/27 release and described the company as employing roughly 17,213 people across ostomy care, continence care, voice and respiratory care, wound care and interventional urology.
items.source: MarketScreener, carrying the GlobeNewswire release from Coloplast A/S

items.claim: The Manila Times republished Coloplast's Financial Calendar 2026/27 announcement, which describes the group's five business areas as Ostomy Care, Continence Care, Voice & Respiratory Care, Wound & Tissue Repair and Interventional Urology.
items.source: The Manila Times, via GlobeNewswire, from Coloplast A/S

items.claim: AD HOC NEWS reported that Coloplast delivered 6% organic growth in Q3 2025/26 and 5% EBIT growth in constant currencies, with nine-month EBIT of DKK 5,599m and a 26% EBIT margin against 27% a year earlier.
items.source: AD HOC NEWS, citing Trivano and Investing.com summaries; editorial responsibility Rafael Muller

items.claim: AD HOC NEWS, in its German edition, reported that Coloplast confirmed organic revenue guidance of 5-6% for the 2025/26 financial year and that Q3 2025/26 organic growth was likewise 6%.
items.source: AD HOC NEWS, editorial responsibility Rafael Muller
